summary: Iteration 9 fully tested: Camera clips (create/list/delete), per-camera RTSP wizard inputs + config persistence, per-camera HLS stream endpoint, voice phrases persistence + Settings UI, plus regressions (PIN, scenes, climate, away). All 8 pytest backend cases pass; all frontend flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1042 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold for split. Consider extracting routers (auth, camera/clips, voice, config) into separate modules for maintainability.
Unused import in server.py: 'socket' imported at module scope but re-imported inside test_connection.

_ensure_ffmpeg spawns per-cam ffmpeg subprocesses without ever terminating stale procs on config change — could leak processes if rtsp_url changes for same cam_id. Consider killing previous proc before restart.
clips collection has no size cap or TTL — motion floods could grow db.clips unbounded. list_clips already limits to 50 but insertion is unlimited.
PUT /api/voice/phrases accepts raw dict — consider Pydantic model for validation.
seed_data_creation: During tests: clips created via /api/camera/{cam_id}/motion (cleaned up); voice phrases {'movie_night':'Movie time'} (cleaned up); config touched then state reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 9 verified. Backend uses ffmpeg (installed) so live=true response works for per-camera stream. Voice phrases stored under db.settings key 'voice_phrases' in field 'map'. Clips stored in db.clips. Wizard's per-camera field testid is wizard-camera-rtsp-{cam_id}; front camera uses wizard-camera-rtsp_url (device-field pattern).
